skill.description: Search Amazon through BrowserAct and collect structured product listing data, including titles, URLs, prices, ratings, reviews, delivery details, and availability.

skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill has intended network access to BrowserAct and one documented command to run the bundled Python script. Most Markdown backtick and reconnaissance detections are false positives. The main security concern is guidance that can encourage users to paste an API key into chat.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that ask users to provide API keys in chat. Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY or a secrets manager.
Document the BrowserAct endpoints, data sent, and retention expectations. Ask for user consent before sending searches.
Document safe quoting for keyword and brand arguments, or provide a wrapper that avoids shell interpolation.
Move the timeout return so successful polling can retrieve and print task results.

content.user_title: Search Amazon Product Data with BrowserAct
content.value_statement: Amazon research can require slow manual collection of listings, prices, ratings, and availability. This skill starts a BrowserAct workflow that searches Amazon and organizes product data.
actual_capabilities: Starts a BrowserAct Amazon product search workflow with an API key.
Accepts search keyword, brand, limit, and language inputs.
Polls BrowserAct task status for up to five minutes.
Prints timestamped status updates and clear API error messages.
Requests listing fields such as title, URL, price, rating, reviews, and availability.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct API key and sends search inputs to BrowserAct.
Depends on BrowserAct and Amazon workflow availability.
The current script can stop after polling before retrieving results.
Does not validate brand, limit, or language beyond positional arguments.

use_cases.title: Compare Brand Listings
use_cases.description: Collect Amazon listing data for one brand and compare prices, ratings, and availability.

use_cases.title: Monitor Product Prices
use_cases.description: Check current prices and list prices for selected products or brands.

use_cases.title: Build Product Catalog Inputs
use_cases.description: Gather product titles, URLs, and availability signals for catalog research.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Product Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Amazon for wireless earbuds from Sony. Limit the result request to 20 products in English.

prompt_templates.title: Listing Quality Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Find laptop stands from Rain Design. Return product names, prices, ratings, review counts, and availability signals.

prompt_templates.title: Localized Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Samsung phone listings in English and Japanese. Use a 50 product limit for each language and summarize price differences.

prompt_templates.title: Multi Brand Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a market research request for ergonomic keyboards across three brands. Include prices, ratings, reviews, monthly sales, and delivery notes.

output_examples.input: Search Sony wireless earbuds, limit 20, English.
output_examples.output: A product research summary with listing titles, Amazon URLs, current prices, ratings, review counts, and availability notes.

output_examples.input: Find Samsung phones and compare discounts.
output_examples.output: A pricing view that compares current prices with list prices and highlights large discount signals.

output_examples.input: Collect laptop stand listings for catalog planning.
output_examples.output: A catalog-ready list of product names, detail links, delivery details, and availability indicators.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the environment before running the skill.
Use specific keywords, brand names, limits, and language values.
Review BrowserAct and Amazon terms before collecting product data.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or prompt text.
Do not request unbounded searches or excessive result counts.
Do not treat monthly sales estimates as audited revenue data.

faq.question: What does this skill search?
faq.answer: It searches Amazon product listings through a BrowserAct workflow.

faq.question: Does it need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Configure BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the environment before use.

faq.question: What inputs can I provide?
faq.answer: You can provide keywords, brand, maximum result count, and language.

faq.question: What product data can it request?
faq.answer: It can request titles, URLs, prices, ratings, reviews, delivery data, and availability.

faq.question: Can it search localized Amazon pages?
faq.answer: It supports language values such as English, German, French, Spanish, Japanese, and Chinese.

faq.question: Is the API key safe to paste into chat?
faq.answer: No. Keep the key in an environment variable or approved secret store.
